title: Catalog Runway: Quarterly execution plan for hosted endpoints and model health
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Produce an executable quarterly plan that aligns hosted endpoints (public API) and model catalog health goals with rollout/rotation windows, canary gating, and cost guardrails. This ticket centralizes the runway and commits holders across product, runtime, and infra for Q2 cycle execution.

Scope:
- Define the catalog lineup and deprecation candidates for the quarter (stable/experimental/legacy).
- Specify canary protocols: traffic allocation, duration, success thresholds (latency, p95, error rate, generation-quality regressions).
- Create model health guardrails (latency SLOs, KV cache hit target, quality delta thresholds on eval prompt sets).
- Cost SLOs per 1k tokens and fallback routing policy for high-cost anomalies.
- Staging and canary infra mapping (eu-west-1-dedicated staging, us-central shadow cluster).
- Rollout windows and rollback plan for hosted endpoints and dedicated pools.

Milestones and acceptance criteria:
- Milestone 1 (by 2026-03-01): Catalog lineup finalized and owners assigned. Acceptance: lineup spreadsheet published in Confluence and linked in this ticket; owners acknowledged.
- Milestone 2 (by 2026-03-15): Canary playbook approved. Acceptance: playbook includes traffic %, duration, metrics, alert thresholds, and automated rollback conditions.
- Milestone 3 (by 2026-03-31): Cost guardrail and routing policy implemented in staging. Acceptance: cost dashboard reflecting per-route cost estimates and a simulated anomaly test completed.
- Milestone 4 (by 2026-04-10): Dry-run canary for one model family (translation-family-v1 -> quantized-v1). Acceptance: no regression beyond quality delta 1.5 and latency within 10% of baseline.

Success metrics (quarter):
- Reduce median token cost for top-10 endpoints by 12% vs. prior quarter (measured on production-weighted sample).
- Maintain p95 latency SLO for high-priority endpoints (<= 300ms).
- KV cache hit rate >= 65% for cached routes.
- Zero severity-1 regressions on customer-facing hosted endpoints during model rotations.

Roles & stakeholders:
- Product: Miguel Santos (owner), Aisha Patel (strategy).
- Runtime/Infra: Priya Reddy (serving runtime), Jackson Lee (capacity & autoscaling).
- Design/Docs: Nina Gomez (docs for rollout playbook).
- Solutions/SE: Tomas Becker (customer comms and early adopters).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Model-quality regressions during quantized rollouts. Mitigation: mandatory eval gate with per-prompt-category thresholds and holdback traffic.
- Risk: Unexpected cost spikes due to fallback routing. Mitigation: simulated load test with cost alarms and short-circuit automatic throttles.
- Risk: Insufficient canary signal coverage. Mitigation: expand eval prompt set and add randomized user-experience synthetic checks.

Artifacts to deliver:
- Confluence: "Catalog Runway Q2'26" (lineup + owners + deprecation plan).
- Runbook: Canary playbook (linked).
- Dashboards: per-route cost + latency + quality regression deck; automated alerts configured in PagerDuty.
- PRs: runtime changes for KV cache instrumentation; routing policy changes.

Next steps (first week):
1) Survey product owners for lineup nominations and lock top-3 candidates. 2) Workshop with runtime on canary telemetry requirements. 3) Create initial Confluence page and assign owners for each milestone.

Notes: this ticket is intentionally cross-functional; expect follow-ups in ENG- and DES- prefixed tickets for implementation details and UX flows.
